# stacklet_anthropic_integration (Data Source)

Retrieve an Anthropic integration.

The admin key is never returned by the API, and `configured` reports whether it holds one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stacklet_anthropic_integration" "example" {
  org_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Anthropic organization.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the API holds an admin key.
- `id` (String) The GraphQL Node ID of the Anthropic integration.
